answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The glacier holds work receipts rather than names, so the echo of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vertex of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
